{{- /* Every published dashboard event or command as a Markdown table, sorted by its type string so each area (FILTER_CONTEXT, LAYOUT, …) reads as one block. The rows come from the `catalog` fields generate-reference.ts (lib/dashboard-catalog.ts) merges into the page version's api_refs.json, so the list follows the SDK and nothing is committed. The "Type guard" / "Create with" header makes render-table.html treat it as an API table: fixed column shares, wrapping identifiers, and collapsed to the first rows behind a "Show all" button. Each row's type string sits under the name, not in its own column: four columns of long code identifiers overflow the content width. Used by the dashboard-catalog shortcode, in the HTML page and in its Markdown copy. Expects: dict "page" "kind" ("event" | "command"), optional "plain" (true: Beta / Alpha as text, not an HTML pill, for the Markdown copy). Returns the table, or a note when the build has no API reference (a local build without the SDK api model). */ -}} {{- $kind := .kind -}} {{- $plain := .plain | default false -}} {{- $refs := (partialCached "api-data.html" .page .page.Section).refs | default dict -}} {{- $rows := slice -}} {{- range $refs -}} {{- if eq (index . "catalog") $kind }}{{ $rows = $rows | append . }}{{ end -}} {{- end -}} {{- $out := printf "_The %s list is generated with the API reference, which this build doesn't include._" $kind -}} {{- if $rows -}} {{- $label := cond (eq $kind "event") "Event" "Command" -}} {{- $out = printf "| %s | %s | Description |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n" $label (cond (eq $kind "event") "Type guard" "Create with") -}} {{- range sort $rows "event_type" -}} {{- $name := printf "`%s`" .title -}} {{- with site.GetPage .path }}{{ $name = printf "[%s](%s)" $name .RelPermalink }}{{ end -}} {{- with .stability }}{{ $name = cond $plain (printf "%s (%s)" $name .) (printf `%s %s` $name (strings.FirstUpper .)) }}{{ end -}} {{- $helpers := slice -}} {{- range .helpers -}} {{- $h := printf "`%s`" .title -}} {{- with .slug }}{{ with index $refs . }}{{ with site.GetPage .path }}{{ $h = printf "[%s](%s)" $h .RelPermalink }}{{ end }}{{ end }}{{ end -}} {{- $helpers = $helpers | append $h -}} {{- end -}} {{- with .event_type }}{{ $name = printf "%s
`%s`" $name . }}{{ end -}} {{- $out = printf "%s| %s | %s | %s |\n" $out $name (delimit $helpers ", " | default "—") (replace (.summary | default "—") "|" "\\|") -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $out -}}
